name: ejector_two_phase_co2
title: Two-phase CO2 ejector (constant-efficiency sections, HEM-choked motive flow)
summary: Transcritical CO2 ejector of Liu & Groll type: motive and suction nozzles with constant isentropic efficiencies, constant-area mixing with a mixing efficiency, diffuser with the Owen et al. two-phase C_t pressure-recovery correlation and homogeneous void fraction; returns section pressures, exhaust state and section areas.

verification.summary: Source example re-run in a throw-away venv (LaboThapPy f03f7f47, CoolProp 8.0.0) after fixing its broken void_fraction import; compare_solution.py: 33 common variables, 1 differ (x_mb, 0 by construction vs 5.8e-6 residue), max rel diff 4.48e-04 (v_mb), pressures <= 1.2e-04; scatter explained by the CoolProp version difference.
verification.reference: LaboThapPy ejector_csteff_example.py re-run (fixed import copy), results in work/ejector_two_phase_co2/reference.csv compared with tools/compare_solution.py
verification.notes: x_mb excluded (0 by construction; the source brentq leaves a 5.8e-06 residue at its branch-jump root). A_d compared with the tight-tolerance root of the C_t correlation (2.05731e-05 m2); the source's stored A_d equals A_mix (its brentq xtol=1e-5 artifact). h_su_1 differs 2.4e-04 (CoolProp 8.1.0dev vs 8.0.0), which shifts P_b_sonic by +872 Pa.
